title: fix(app-shell): the action, agent, skill, tool and job previews and the CEL try-it dialog read the designer locale (objectui#10862, slice 1)
body:
Part of #10862
Clause-②: no — rows are added and a locale is passed; each en row equals today's literal. No declared surface or stored value moves.

Slice 1 of 3 (the flow / automation previews), per triage `5860733428`: one card, landed in slices by preview family. #10862 stays open for the object / data slice and the admin slice.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 PM (claim `5860844842`, session `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`), implemented on `claude/issue-10862-designer-english-slice-1` as two commits on `main` `a7fd877`: `d9346a0` (the slice) and `aa8601e` (the CI fix and the review round, see "CI fix" below). It uses the objectui#10832 / #10850 / #10857 shape: `engine.*` rows whose en value is the literal each replaces, plus zh, read in the designer locale the surface already receives.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **`previews/ActionPreview.tsx`** (the card's site 2 and its site-4 census). The pills ("AI: opted out", "AI: exposed", "refresh after", and the type / object / variant labels), "Locations:", "Requires:", "Visible when", "Disabled when", "On click" and the handler sentence for every action type, "First asks:", "On success:", the "Where it appears" section with its capability note and the placement frames' mock text, the test-request panel, the input-dialog mock (its buttons, the carry-over line, the param placeholders and notes) and the result-dialog mock's defaults.
- **`previews/AgentPreview.tsx`, `SkillPreview.tsx`, `ToolPreview.tsx`, `JobPreview.tsx`** (site 4's census). Empty prompts, section headings, pills, table headers, notes, the "Try in chat" and "Open in API Console" links and their tooltips, the skill's `missing` cell and its tooltip, and the job's next-run list.
- **`celAuthoring.ts`** (site 3). `testRunCelPredicate` hands the two sentences it writes itself back as a `messageKey` instead of English text: "The predicate is empty." (`engine.celTest.predicateEmpty`) and the "Evaluation failed." fallback, which reuses `engine.flowSim.note.evaluationFailed`: same English, same meaning (a CEL evaluation failed and the engine gave no message) at all five sites that read it. The engine's own message passes through as written, as `message`. The module takes no locale and imports nothing at load.
- **`CelTestRunDialog.tsx`**, the one place those two sentences render. Its banner reads the `messageKey` through the `t` its host binds to the designer locale. Bounded in-place fix in the same file, same defect class and same gates: its own sample-JSON refusal "expected a JSON object." reads `engine.celTest.notObject` through the same `t`. The seat should add this file to the claim's surface; it is where the dry run's words are read.
- **`i18n.ts`.** 128 new en rows, each the literal it replaces, and 128 zh rows beside them. No existing row moves.
- **Pins.** `previews/automationPreviews.i18n-10862.test.tsx` and `CelTestRunDialog.i18n-10862.test.tsx`, 66 cases (see below).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/10862-designer-automation-previews-locale.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

## The seam

- **The five previews read the `locale` prop** their `MetadataPreviewProps` already carry. Every production host passes `useMetadataLocale()` as that prop: `ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor` and `StudioDesignSurface`. So no new prop and no hook: the preview reads what its host hands it. The prop is also what the gallery's `?locale=` feeds, so these previews follow it there (the hook-read gap disclosed on objectui#10857 does not apply to them).
- **The dry run's words are read where the translator already is.** `CelTestRunDialog` has one locale source, the `t` its only host (`PermissionMatrixEditor`) binds from `useMetadataLocale()`. It translates the `messageKey` the dry run hands back. No locale is threaded through `PermissionAdvancedFacets`, and `celAuthoring.ts` stays free of any import at load, as it was at the base.
- **New static edges:** only the five previews now import `../i18n.js`, and each already reached it through `PreviewShell` (objectui#10857). A static-import closure diff of all 840 test files in `packages/app-shell` against the base finds no test whose closure grew at `aa8601e`. The same instrument lists 19 at `d9346a0`, the skew test among them, as its lit control. `check:eager-closure` needs a console build and was not run here (NOT MEASURED, left to CI).

## Census, confirmed per file

Counts are rendered English sites, read at source and each pinned through the real component. "Rows" below counts the rows each file reads. A plural pair or a branch pair of one literal is two rows, for example `paramsOne` / `paramsOther`.

| File | Sites converted | Not counted, and why |
|---|---|---|
| `ActionPreview.tsx` | 58: 57 new rows plus the reused `engine.cancel` | `INHERITED_TARGET` "(inherited from the bound field)" is never rendered: it is a non-empty stand-in handed to `paramDegradesWithoutTarget`. Identifiers: the location frame labels (`record_header` and the rest), the `reference` code span, the default body language `expression`, the `param_N` fallback name and the component token. Protocol text: the "HTTP 200 OK" status line. Author data: label, name, target, confirm and success text, param labels, placeholders and help text, option labels, result-dialog title, description, acknowledge text and field labels, script source. Producer text: the fetch error and the response body. |
| `AgentPreview.tsx` | 19 | Identifiers: the rail keys (`maxIterations`, `short.maxMessages`, `long.enabled`, `long.store`). Author data: provider, model, guardrail keys and values, permissions, label, role, instructions. |
| `SkillPreview.tsx` | 16 | Author data: tool names and the condition cells. |
| `ToolPreview.tsx` | 14 | Identifiers: the JSON-Schema type labels (`string`, `any`, `ref`, array forms) and the example call's JSON with its type stubs. Author data: parameter names and descriptions. |
| `JobPreview.tsx` | 20 | "Cron" is the name of the syntax and reads the same in every locale. Compact durations (`5m`, `30s`, `2h`) are the notation the schedule is written in. Author data: timezone, handler key and label. The fire times were already formatted in the display locale (objectui#9909). |
| `celAuthoring.ts` | 2 | Its two lint advisories are not in this slice; see "Out of scope" below. |
| `CelTestRunDialog.tsx` | 1 (in place) | The JSON parser's own message passes through as written. |

The five files' premise holds at the base `a7fd877`: none of them imported the designer `t`. `JobPreview` imported `@object-ui/i18n` only for `useDisplayLocale()`.

## CI fix (`aa8601e`)

- **Symptom.** `Test (shard 2/8)` was red at `d9346a0`. `clientValidation.skew.test.tsx` failed at import with `[vitest] No "VIEW_FILTER_LIST_VALUE_OPERATORS" export is defined on the "@objectstack/spec/ui" mock`.
- **Root cause, this PR's.**
  - `d9346a0` gave `celAuthoring.ts` a static import of `./i18n.js`.
  - `i18n.ts` imports `useObjectTranslation` from `@object-ui/i18n`. Its `utils/number-display.ts` value-re-exports from `@object-ui/core`, whose index re-exports `utils/filter-converter`. That module spreads `VIEW_FILTER_LIST_VALUE_OPERATORS` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` at load.
  - At the base, `celAuthoring.ts` reached `@object-ui/core` only through a dynamic `import()`. So every importer of `lintCelPredicate`, `clientValidation.ts` among them, now loaded that graph eagerly.
  - The skew test replaces `@objectstack/spec/ui` wholesale, so it failed before any case ran.
  - It is the only test in the repo that mocks `@objectstack/spec/ui`. The other 18 tests whose closure grew were green at `d9346a0`, but they loaded the extra graph.
- **Fix, and why this one.** The dry run returns its two sentences as catalogue keys, and the dialog translates them through the `t` it already holds.
  - Its reach is the two files that own the seam. It removes the edge rather than working around it in one test.
  - `celAuthoring.ts` is import-free again, so no mock anywhere can sit upstream of the catalogue through it.
  - The dialog loses its second locale source.
  - The alternative, making the skew mock inherit the real module, would have left the new edge in place for all 19 tests. It would also have left it for any later full-replacement mock of `@objectstack/spec/ui`, `@object-ui/core` or `@object-ui/i18n` upstream of `celAuthoring.ts`. The test is untouched.
- **Reproduced before, green after**, each through the verify lock:
  - At `d9346a0`: `Test Files 1 failed (1)`, `Tests no tests`, with the error above at `filter-converter.ts` and `element-data-source.ts`.
  - At `aa8601e`: the skew file's 4 cases pass, `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 70 passed (70)` with the two pin files.
- **Review round, same commit.** `renderFieldMock`'s lookup placeholder keeps the base's nullish reading of `reference` (`reference ?? 'records'`): an empty string is not "records".
  - A new pin covers the empty-string edge in en and zh.
  - Measured: through the real component, a lookup param with `reference: ''` never reaches the Search placeholder. `paramDegradesWithoutTarget` reads the empty target as missing, so it renders the degraded record-id box and the no-reference note.
  - The en case passes on the base `ActionPreview` source too (base blob restored, `git diff HEAD` empty), so the edge renders byte-equal to the base.

## H1: reproduced on the base, under zh-CN, through the real components

This is the red run of the new pins, run at `d9346a0`. The seven component sources were at the base `a7fd877`: the five previews, `celAuthoring.ts` and `CelTestRunDialog.tsx`. For each, the blob equalled the base blob. The rows and pins were at HEAD. A trap restored the sources afterwards: each blob equalled HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes.

Result: `Tests 31 failed | 33 passed (64)`.

- The 31 failures are exactly the zh cases that carry a site. The one zh case that stayed green is the producer pass-through control.
- All 32 en controls passed on the base sources. Between them they render all 128 new en rows and the two reused ones. So each en row renders exactly what the base literal rendered.
- The failure diffs list 125 unrendered zh sites across the list-shaped cases.
- Quoted from the diffs: "Navigate to /orders" and "Run flow approve_order" where zh was expected, and "The predicate is empty." and "Evaluation failed." in the zh dialog's error banner, under its already-zh title 求值错误.

Lit control, green on the base on the same mount: the dialog's error-banner title (`perm.cel.test.error`, 求值错误).

## Pins and ablation

The pins use the objectui#10748 / #10804 / #10835 / #10848 harness. Each case mounts the real preview or dialog under `I18nProvider` in its language and reads what rendered: an element's whole text, a `title`, or a `placeholder`. Each zh value is read back from the catalogue and guarded by `zhRow` (not the echoed key, not the en row). Each en value is read through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`. On the same mounts, each case checks a sample of author data, identifiers and producer text, and expects them verbatim in both locales.

Two stand-ins are used:
- `fetch` is stubbed so the test-request panel shows its sending and network-error states.
- The `__setCelFormulaLoader` seam hands the dry run an engine whose failure carries no message. That is the only way to reach the fallback. The empty-predicate result is reached through the real dialog: the selected clause's predicate is cleared by a re-render while the dialog is open.

Offline cross-check: every one of the 128 new rows is read by the code and asserted by a pin.

- **Head** `aa8601e`: `Tests 66 passed (66)`. The two pin files are also inside the related-suite run below.
- **Ablation**, one mutation, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on `aa8601e`, on the seam as it now stands:
  - Change: in `CelTestRunDialog`'s banner, `{outcome.messageKey ? t(outcome.messageKey) : outcome.message}` became `{outcome.message}`.
  - Anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `ea530a7049` → `163cf26660`.
  - Result: `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`. The 4 failures are exactly the two self-worded dry-run sentences, in zh and in en. The producer pass-through and sample-JSON cases stayed green.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD (`ea530a7049`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The earlier ablation at `d9346a0` targeted the `useMetadataLocale()` read that `aa8601e` removed. It gave `2 failed | 62 passed (64)`.
- The pins import the sources by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.

## Gates

Every line below was run on HEAD `aa8601e` unless it says `d9346a0`.

- **Related suites, 174 files, in three locked batches: 59 / 56 / 59 files, 624 / 636 / 1123 tests, all passed.** They are the 164 files run at `d9346a0` plus the tests that name `celAuthoring` or `clientValidation`, the skew test among them. They cover:
  - the whole `previews/` tree;
  - every test file that names one of the seven changed components, `PermissionAdvancedFacets` or `PermissionMatrixEditor`;
  - the metadata-admin i18n pin files;
  - the i18n gate scripts' own suites and the icon-record and spec-symbol ledger suites.
- **Declared narrowing.** The full `packages/app-shell` suite is left to CI.
- **Type check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28/28 tasks). `--listFilesOnly` shows that `tsconfig.test.json` compiles both new pin files.
- **eslint on the 10 changed source and test files**, at `d9346a0`. At `aa8601e`, the 6 files it touched have 0 errors and 1 warning: the same `set-state-in-effect` the base `CelTestRunDialog` carries.
  - Every file is inside eslint's config (`--print-config` exits 0 for each).
  - `--format json`: 10 files, 0 errors, 9 warnings. The base versions of the same files carry the same 9: `no-explicit-any` ×4 in `AgentPreview`, ×2 in `JobPreview`, `exhaustive-deps` ×2 in `ToolPreview` and `set-state-in-effect` ×1 in `CelTestRunDialog`.
  - No type-aware linting is configured (no `projectService` or `project` in `eslint.config.js`), and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads the disk. So this diff cannot change any verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint is CI's.
- **The remaining gates.**
  - `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0: "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."
  - `check:i18n-drift` 0: "No designer-table en value changed in this range." (128 keys added, 0 en values changed.)
  - `check:i18n-keys` 0 and `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0.
  - `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new) and `check:control-bytes` 0.
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0, re-run at `aa8601e`.
  - `check:test-path-roots` 0, `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 and `check:icon-record-names` 0.
  - `check:changeset-claims` 0. It is report-only and lists four pending changesets that name a touched file: 6310, 6329, 7125 and 8632. Each paragraph was read and is still true.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
  - `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0 and `check-changeset-fixed` 0.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED (11 paths).
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only. None of the 128 new rows is listed as a candidate.
- **NOT MEASURED: a browser drive of the preview gallery.** Reason: the console's Vite dev server exited at startup in this worktree with a dependency-resolution error on `react-map-gl`. The error is outside this diff and was not investigated. The pins above read the same components the gallery mounts.

## Out of scope

- **`celAuthoring.ts`'s two lint advisories render English under zh-CN.** One is the local fallback of the wrong-root advisory ("… is not the row on this surface …"). The other is the pushdown advisory ("This read filter isn't a simple field comparison (…) …"). `CelPredicateField` shows both beneath the RLS and field-rule CEL editors. Localizing them needs a locale through `lintCelPredicate` and its callers: `CelPredicateField`, `ConditionalFormattingEditor`, `ConditionBuilder`, `ObjectFieldInspector` and `clientValidation`. All of those are outside this slice's surface. This is a read at source, not a browser drive. Carrier: this card, for a later slice.

## Pending changesets

- `.changeset/olive-crabs-visit.md` says the agent rail's empty collection renders `EmptyDescription` "with the text "No values set."". After this PR that sentence is true in en. Under zh the row is now localized: 未设置任何值。

## Acceptance notes

- `describeHandler`'s form sentence names the path "/console/forms/NAME". `AgentPreview`'s own note says the console declares no path beginning with `/console`. The text is kept byte for byte, per the family rule. It is an observation only, not a card. Carrier: none.
